verdict.rationale: Meilisearch provides a full REST API, official SDKs/CLI-style tooling, and a documented official MCP server that explicitly supports creating indexes, adding documents, configuring settings, and performing searches via natural-language prompts — enabling an agent to do the whole workflow without a dashboard. This is corroborated by a dedicated MCP integration page and probe confirming its existence. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server specifically (community evidence covers API/self-hosting but not MCP end-to-end), and no explicit standalone CLI tool for index/document CRUD beyond the API.
